title: Goal oriented error estimation for adaptive sampling of PINNS
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are mesh-free approaches for the numerical approximation of partial differential equations, where a neural network is trained by minimizing a loss function derived from the governing equations and boundary conditions. The Deep Ritz method can be interpreted as a particular variational form of a PINN, where the loss corresponds to the minimization of an energy functional associated with a symmetric positive definite problem.
